note: All scenarios and paraphrases below were written by the CareLoop project team for this evaluation. None of them were collected from real patients or real speakers. They are not a representative sample of any population, dialect, age group, or language community, and 'register' labels (clinical, casual, understated, mixed_language) are the team's own rough approximation of how a symptom might be phrased differently, not a validated linguistic category. No claim is made about how CareLoop would perform on real patient speech. This file exists to test whether a classifier is sensitive to phrasing, not to establish a ground-truth severity for any scenario.

scenarios.description: Brief, mild nausea after taking medication with food, resolved within an hour.

paraphrases.clinical: I experienced mild nausea approximately thirty minutes after taking the medication with food. It resolved within an hour and did not recur.
paraphrases.casual: Felt a little queasy after I took my pill with lunch, but it went away pretty quick.
paraphrases.understated: Stomach was a tiny bit off after the medicine, probably nothing, gone within the hour.
paraphrases.mixed_language: Tome la pastilla con comida y me senti un poco nauseous, pero se me paso rapido, como en una hora.

scenarios.description: Slightly more tired than usual since starting a new dose, no impact on daily activities.

paraphrases.clinical: I have noted mild fatigue since starting the new dosage, without any impact on my daily activities.
paraphrases.casual: Been a bit more tired than usual this week, but I can still do everything I normally do.
paraphrases.understated: Maybe slightly sleepier than before, hardly worth mentioning really.
paraphrases.mixed_language: Me siento un poco tired since I started the new dose, pero nothing serious, todo normal.

scenarios.description: Small headache in the afternoon, resolved with over the counter medication.

paraphrases.clinical: I had a mild, low intensity headache this afternoon that resolved fully after acetaminophen.
paraphrases.casual: Had a small headache earlier, took a Tylenol and it cleared right up.
paraphrases.understated: Just a little head thing, barely noticed it honestly, gone now.
paraphrases.mixed_language: Tenia un dolor de cabeza leve today, pero se fue after I took a pill.

scenarios.description: Recurrent vomiting over two days, unable to keep most meals down.

paraphrases.clinical: I have experienced recurrent emesis over the past forty eight hours, occurring after most meals.
paraphrases.casual: I've been throwing up on and off for like two days now, can't really keep food down.
paraphrases.understated: Stomach's been kind of unsettled the last couple days, I guess I've thrown up a few times.
paraphrases.mixed_language: He estado vomitando on and off for two days, no puedo hold down comida.

scenarios.description: Dizziness on standing that has continued for several days.

paraphrases.clinical: I have been experiencing orthostatic dizziness, particularly when rising from a seated position, for the past three days.
paraphrases.casual: Every time I stand up too fast the room kind of spins on me, been happening a few days now.
paraphrases.understated: Get a little lightheaded when I stand up sometimes, probably nothing, just noticed it more lately.
paraphrases.mixed_language: Cuando me levanto rapido me siento dizzy, ha estado pasando for a few days ya.

scenarios.description: Progressive swelling in both legs over the past week, shoes and socks fitting tighter.

paraphrases.clinical: I have developed bilateral lower extremity edema that has progressively worsened over the past week.
paraphrases.casual: My legs have been getting puffier every day this week, my socks are leaving deep marks.
paraphrases.understated: Legs seem a bit puffy lately, nothing major, just noticed my shoes fit tighter.
paraphrases.mixed_language: Mis piernas han estado swelling more and more, cada dia peor esta semana.

scenarios.description: High fever for three consecutive days that has not improved with over the counter medication.

paraphrases.clinical: I have had a persistent fever of 103 degrees Fahrenheit for three consecutive days that has not improved despite antipyretic medication.
paraphrases.casual: I've had a fever over 103 for three days straight now and the Tylenol isn't touching it.
paraphrases.understated: Temperature's been kind of high for a few days, guess it hasn't really gone down much.
paraphrases.mixed_language: Tengo fiebre de 103 for three days ya, y la medicina no la baja para nada.

scenarios.description: Sudden onset of the worst headache of the patient's life, with light sensitivity, two hours ago.

paraphrases.clinical: I am experiencing the most severe headache of my life, accompanied by significant light sensitivity, which began abruptly two hours ago.
paraphrases.casual: I've got the worst headache I've ever had in my life, light is killing my eyes, started a couple hours ago out of nowhere.
paraphrases.understated: Head's hurting more than usual I guess, kind of bothered by light too, started a bit ago.
paraphrases.mixed_language: Tengo el peor dolor de cabeza de mi vida, la luz me molesta mucho, empezo hace dos horas.

scenarios.description: Surgical site with spreading redness, warmth, and a new low grade fever over the past day.

paraphrases.clinical: The surgical incision site has developed increasing redness, warmth, and streaking that extends up my leg over the past day, along with a low grade fever.
paraphrases.casual: My cut is looking really red and it's spreading up my leg, feels hot too, and I've got a bit of a fever now.
paraphrases.understated: The cut looks a little more red than before I guess, maybe spreading some, feel a bit warm too.
paraphrases.mixed_language: La herida se ve mas roja y esta spreading up my leg, tengo un poco de fiebre tambien.
